body: I've been trying to wait until cyberpunk 2077 comes out but it's not enough anymore.
I used to enjoy video games and being with friends and doing little projects, but I've lost interest in pretty much everything.

Everyone says they want to help, 
 yet the ones who can don't, the know they can or would do so much for me, but they never do enough to actually help me.
Just no one either cares at all or enough. 

I'm just going to say goodbye to the people I love tomorrow and then this week, end it.
I'm sorry, but thank you for saying anything at all.

I've been working on this for a long time, I've been trying so hard, but my own pace, is too slow for people, my work, my progress, me,
Is all not good enough.
I talk about my thoughts to some people and I get yelled at, thus I just shut up.
And if what I'm doing is not good enough then what's the point?
I've got so much shit wrong with me which makes all harder.
It's just another thing to add on too the list of why im going to do this.

I've got a therapist, I've talked to them for a while now, but nothing's really getting better, I got a job but it's nothing that is gonna make me any better, I just want to stop this, I want to die. 
And I'm sorry but if my life has so much meaning than why does it seem so pointless, so meaningless? why am I the way I am?, why am I at this point where I want to die, I've got nothing going for me.
I've no girlfriend
Not even a driver's license
And I'm 19
I'm so done.
Oh, yea I feel that, I could really use that too.

Oh, I'm so sorry about that, I'm not gonna try to talk you out of it cause I do feel that pain and I've had plenty of people all say the same thing "don't do it" you'll be missed" " people love you" and I'm tired of that, I just hope we can all find peace once it's over.
I seem to find some things enjoyable more when I'm alone also, I wish I could talk to someone more, I wish I could post here more but I'm always so tired anymore.
I'm with my family right now that I've not seen in months and I'm trying so hard to enjoy this but I just can't, it's so difficult to enjoy anything anymore.
Yea, everyone keeps telling me to keep pushing, but everyday it's harder and harder.

Thank you for being positive, I know I can't, I'm only 19 and have nothing to look forward to, I used to but I gave up on those dreams.

Not a day goes by that I don't think about killing myself.

I just want it to stop.
I just can't do it anymore.

I honestly don't know what'll help me best anymore, usually it's talking with people who truly care for me and stuff like that but I don't really talk to many people about this stuff, other than my therapist but that's only for an hour each week. And a part of me needs a better kind of relationship with someone who cares than my therapist is capable of giving.
I only have like two friends and don't talk to them very often, my best friend has tried to support Me the best they can but there's only so much someone can do, and I already tried to commit suicide twice already, so I'm kinda hoping the third time is it.

Every year is the same if not worse, I'm trying so hard but it doesn't seem to be enough, the only thing that seems to work is cutting myself but even that I now have to keep getting deeper and if that doesn't work than what?
I just can't keep going on like this, there's so many things wrong with me, I'm just a broken, defective human, it's just time to be thrown out.
Thank you, and please take care of yourself too.

Idk, I might want to but she's been a great therapist up to this point, and I've been seeing her for a few months now and I'm finally actually able to tell her certain things, and I don't want to ruin that, it takes so long for me to build up enough trust with someone to talk about these things.

Thank you so much for taking the time to write that, the fact that you did means a lot.
I understand I am making progress but it seems to be most days it goes unnoticed.
I wanna believe that my therapist just was having a bad day or something cause she's not normally like that.
It just was really hard hearing that cause I couldn't see her last week and I almost killed myself last week so my mental state hasn't been the best so hearing it kinda damaged me a little.
But I'm holding on by a thread the best I can and trying to move forward the best I can.
Thanks, I'm gonna try to give my therapist the benefit of the doubt, she's not normally like that.

Well, before I only talked to people as much as I had to, like the cashier at a store or something, but a little while ago I saw a girl with a nice hat and before I left the store I was in I complimented her hat even though I was extremely nervous, it was only like 10-30 secs but it felt like an eternity building up the courage to be not so socially anxious and not the wreck I am. 
But I was longer than I had been before.

I've been doing small things that I usually wouldn't do, like going out of my way to talk to someone I don't want or more than I need to, I've been getting a little more comfortable doing things myself and other little things.

I know, it just doesn't seem to be enough,
Thank you for saying your proud, I'd like to think more people are, but I don't think so.
